card.fires_on: Words inside teaching materials such as lesson plans, lab instructions and class assignments, often just before a task or objective is stated ("we are going to", "write a letter", "the objective is"). It fires on small linking words, not one fixed word.

modes.description: Small words like are, of, the or 's in teacher-style sentences that lead into what students will do or learn.
